06 · Visual guidelines
Keep the product consistent across desktop, mobile, web and marketing.
✦BackgroundsUse deep navy, not pure black, for the main canvas.
◉InteractionUse cyan for focus, selected states and active navigation.
✧HighlightsReserve gold for important moments and small accents.
●StatusUse green for connected/healthy, amber for warning, red for error.
Accessibility tip: Use near-white text on dark surfaces and dark navy text on light surfaces. Do not place small text directly on bright cyan or gold. Check contrast for every real component before shipping.
Recommended direction: Make Cosmic Blue the default brand theme. Offer Minimal Midnight for users who prefer less visual glow, Aurora as an expressive accent theme, and Cosmic Light as the light-mode option.
